reoptimization.method: Read scenario.json, analysis-inputs.json and run-manifest.json directly from the canonical ZIP; call soma.engine.plan_run with the archived scenario, archived analysis inputs and details.scheduler_options; compare the resulting allocations against archived result.json.

stored_state_review.exact_sample_test: tests/web/display.test.mjs checks equality at the stored spacecraft epoch, preserves reference metadata, rejects missing frame metadata and returns no spacecraft sample at the next second.
stored_state_review.interpretation: Absence of a relay trajectory does not authorize a fabricated state. Exact stored-time behavior is tested separately with a declared synthetic state. This review inspected those tests; it does not claim to have rerun the browser suite.

acceptance_scope.demonstration: Controlled same-day data-ready-time change; unsupported site/date behavior remains explicit. No physical site/date relay rescue is claimed.
acceptance_scope.public_deployment_condition: Unresolved corrected-ion permission remains a separate public-hosting restriction, not evidence that scientific reproduction failed.
